clauses.clause: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {R}.
If you do, target creature can't block this turn.

mapping.notes: ENGINE (weaker than printed): a triggered ability whose only target sits in a combat event slot (IS_ANY_TARGET in DeclareBlockersEvent.filter, the form Sneaking Guide and Goblin Smuggler use as activations) is never designated: binding._designation_slots reads TARGET Selectors and designated players only, and query._designation_only_slot serves activation_target_slots alone. No target is chosen, so the paid {R} does nothing (and the trigger is not removed when no creature can be targeted, CR 603.3d). Repro (fails today, run with cardtool runpack FDN): tools/scenarios/known_bugs/frenzied_goblin_trigger_target_cant_block_never_designated.json.
